pageHero.title: Meet Purdi
pageHero.tag: Registered nurse, founder of Cottage Aesthetics — and the reason clients call it simply "The Cottage."

about.title: Hello, I'm Purdi
about.body1: I'm a registered nurse with over 15 years of NHS and private healthcare experience, and the founder of Cottage Aesthetics — which has proudly welcomed clients for the past 18 months.
about.body2: Throughout my career I've worked within Plastic Surgery, Dermatology and specialist reconstructive services, caring for patients undergoing life-changing procedures. Working alongside highly skilled surgeons gave me an exceptional understanding of skin health, wound healing, facial anatomy, and the importance of precision, symmetry and attention to detail.
about.body3: These environments taught me that every patient is unique — the very best outcomes come from understanding the individual in front of you, respecting their natural features and creating results that look balanced, refreshed and authentically them.

philosophy.title: Everyone deserves high-quality care — without inflated prices
philosophy.body1: Great care extends far beyond the treatment itself. Trust, honesty, safety and communication are at the heart of every positive journey. I believe you should fully understand your options, feel confident in your practitioner, and know you're receiving care based on knowledge, experience and evidence.
philosophy.body2: Enhancing our appearance should never mean fitting into a mould where everyone leaves looking identical. My goal is simply to help you look and feel like the best version of yourself — never changing who you are, just enhancing what makes you uniquely you. That means longer appointments, honest consultations, individual treatment plans, premium products and genuinely natural-looking results.

cottage.title: A calm retreat in the Worcestershire countryside
cottage.body1: Cottage Aesthetics sits in the peaceful village of Hartlebury, tucked away from the busy high street. Limewashed walls, olive trees, oak and antique brass — every detail is here so you relax from the moment you arrive.
cottage.body2: Complete privacy · easy free parking · longer, unhurried appointments · a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

creds.title: Care you can trust
creds.item1: Registered with the Nursing & Midwifery Council (NMC)
creds.item3: Advanced training in every treatment offered
creds.item4: Currently completing a Level 7 qualification in Aesthetic Medicine
